title: Locked environment records no interpreter version
description: Gemfile.lock declares a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section.
limitation: It matches a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section in the parsed Gemfile.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
